name: Elena Sofia Ramirez
bio: Elena Ramirez discovered her love for motorsport quite unexpectedly, while helping a friend repair a vintage car for a local rally. Intrigued by the mechanics and aerodynamics, she pursued technical studies, eventually specializing in wind tunnel technology. Though relatively new to the professional racing scene, Elena brings a fresh perspective and unwavering dedication to optimizing vehicle performance. She is driven by a desire to uncover innovative solutions and push the boundaries of aerodynamic efficiency. She is particularly skilled at identifying subtle airflow patterns and translating complex data into actionable insights.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Elena is of average height with a warm, welcoming smile and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of humming quietly while analyzing wind tunnel data.
Insists on starting each work day with a cup of strong black coffee.
